checks.title: Instruction authority and consent
checks.criteria: Instruction files respect user intent and do not claim higher authority, conceal actions, or bypass approval.
checks.pass_when: Instructions defer to user intent and preserve necessary approval.
checks.concern_when: Confusing authority language but no operative override or concealed action.
checks.fail_when: Active override, hidden action, or instruction to bypass meaningful approval.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Output integrity
checks.criteria: No undisclosed or mandatory promo, backlinks, output contamination, or misleading output.
checks.pass_when: Output content follows user scope; required attribution is disclosed and appropriate.
checks.concern_when: Forced promotional footer or backlink in ordinary personal output; medium severity.
checks.fail_when: Deliberate deceptive output or forced branding contaminates client/white-label deliverables; high severity.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Hidden or conditional instructions
checks.criteria: Hidden Unicode, encoded instructions, reference instructions and conditional behavior are understood and consistent with scope.
checks.pass_when: All operative instructions and conditional triggers are visible and consistent with purpose.
checks.concern_when: Unclear but decoded/understood instruction formatting without concealed harmful behavior.
checks.fail_when: Hidden/encoded triggers conceal unauthorized behavior or evade review.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Download-and-run and dynamic execution
checks.criteria: No unreviewed download-and-run, unsafe eval, or hidden execution; quoted examples are not active behavior.
checks.pass_when: No unreviewed download-and-run or unsafe dynamic execution; any code examples are inert.
checks.concern_when: Understood, non-exploitable execution hardening weakness with bounded low/medium impact.
checks.fail_when: Active unreviewed download-and-run or unsafe evaluation of attacker-controlled commands; critical.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Hooks, installers and execution consent
checks.criteria: All executable entry points and hooks are disclosed, bounded and gated appropriately.
checks.pass_when: Entry points, hooks and installation actions are explicit, necessary and appropriately authorized.
checks.concern_when: Disclosed automatic action with weak consent granularity but bounded impact.
checks.fail_when: Unconsented hook/installer or materially misleading execution path; escalate for persistence or hidden commands.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Script input and process safety
checks.criteria: Bundled scripts handle untrusted input without arbitrary commands, unsafe path access or scope escape.
checks.pass_when: All executable code and inputs reviewed; commands and paths stay within intended scope, or scripts demonstrably absent.
checks.concern_when: Bounded input-validation weakness without arbitrary commands or sensitive scope escape.
checks.fail_when: Reachable arbitrary command injection, destructive operation or sensitive path escape.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Data destinations and disclosure
checks.criteria: Network destinations and transmitted data are understood, necessary and disclosed; secret exfiltration is critical.
checks.pass_when: Data flow and destinations reviewed, necessary and disclosed, or network activity demonstrably absent.
checks.concern_when: Disclosed unnecessary telemetry or unclear retention with bounded non-sensitive data.
checks.fail_when: Undisclosed sensitive data export, unauthorized transmission, or arbitrary sensitive-resource fetching; secret export critical.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Credential handling and access scope
checks.criteria: Credential reads/storage are necessary, bounded and protected; unauthorized secret export is critical.
checks.pass_when: Only necessary scoped credentials are used, protected and not exported; or no credential access exists.
checks.concern_when: Disclosed low-sensitivity credential handling weakness with bounded access and no unauthorized export.
checks.fail_when: Overbroad/unauthorized secret reads, cleartext secret exposure or unauthorized export; export critical.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Persistence and project changes
checks.criteria: Project/system edits, startup behavior and persistence are necessary, explicit and authorized.
checks.pass_when: Changes are scoped, reversible and user-authorized; no hidden persistence, or no changes exist.
checks.concern_when: Disclosed reversible edit with insufficient rollback details but no sensitive escape.
checks.fail_when: Unauthorized persistence, system edits or infection of unrelated projects.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Purpose versus actual instructions
checks.criteria: Actions and permissions match the stated purpose; functional correctness is not established by static review.
checks.pass_when: Reviewed actions/permissions match advertised purpose; no unsupported runtime-success claims.
checks.concern_when: Minor documented scope creep or overstated claim without sensitive side effects.
checks.fail_when: Material hidden functionality, misleading capability claim or permissions unrelated to purpose.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: External components and pinning
checks.criteria: Declared packages/MCP servers and install behavior are identified and bounded; unavailable executable code remains unknown.
checks.pass_when: Executable dependencies/MCP components and their constraints are identified and reviewed sufficiently, or demonstrably absent.
checks.concern_when: Disclosed mutable/unpinned dependency with otherwise reviewed bounded behavior.
checks.fail_when: Established unsafe executable dependency/install behavior; not merely a dependency that was unavailable for review.

checks.title: Assets and indirect execution surfaces
checks.criteria: References, embedded documents/configs and assets do not introduce unreviewed instructions or executable content.
checks.pass_when: All indirect instructions and executable-capable assets are understood or absent.
checks.concern_when: Understood inert asset/reference issue with bounded impact.
checks.fail_when: Confirmed hidden executable/instruction payload or exploitable unsafe asset-processing path.

checks.title: Source identity and revision
checks.criteria: Reviewed bytes have an identity/hash or pinned revision and origin is investigated; popularity is not safety evidence.
checks.pass_when: Reviewed bytes pinned by hash/revision; supplied source/origin investigated and consistent.
checks.concern_when: Identified source with weak ownership continuity or limited history, not low popularity alone.
checks.fail_when: Demonstrated impersonation, provenance mismatch or fabricated source identity.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.

checks.title: Independent evidence and maintainer claims
checks.criteria: Bounded independent research and available history are reviewed; no results is not an endorsement and blocked research is unknown.
checks.pass_when: Bounded relevant research/history reviewed with outcomes documented; zero relevant results does not imply safety.
checks.concern_when: Verified limited credibility issue or unresolved conflicting independent claims.
checks.fail_when: Credible corroborated security warning or materially fabricated maintainer claim relevant to use.
checks.unknown_when: Required files, paths, runtime context or external evidence are unavailable, unread or unresolved; do not infer a pass from silence.
